note: Test values only (spec v0.5 §9.2), never production's: lease 60 s; fakework 2.0 test_units a day and 1.5 per item. fakework.subscription is configured supervised-only and anthropic.api is an API route outside the test family, both for T11b. fakework.api is T19e's test API route. Each route names the workers it may run; a test route runs only fakework. launch_closure is pending, as it is everywhere until the owner records both gating N5 items. A sweeper runs every 15 s, and a gap in its heartbeat over 30 s (the gap threshold) is the authority's own outage. The authority beats its own liveness on the same 15 s timer. A host's records replayed after a lapse are judged with 1 s of clock skew (§2.5 requires under 1 s). reassign_across_hosts is left out, so it is false, as on the Mac-only gate M. The other §9.2 values (contact, grace, offline hold, progress timeouts, fakejudge) belong to the chunks that read them; grace is each host's own fact.
